I finished this game completely but keep in mind I bought it when it was new and expensive. It's extremely repetitive and I cannot recommend it for this reason. There are limited action attack moves and the bosses and fight scense are frankly, boring. There are many other better games to buy than this. 5.5/10

Probably the best WH40K game out there.

Understand before buying that this is one of those games where the MP was a large part of the appeal. It's suffered a lot from lack of online players. If you buy, skip any DLC if it adds to the price, because all the additional content is for multiplayer that has completely dried up. If you have some friends to try it out with, there's a pretty good cooperative mode that only takes 3-4 people.

The single player campaign has its flaws - there aren't many weapons to shake up the gameplay with and the whole thing is on rails with no real differences between playthroughs. It has moments where it shines. Some encounters are genuinely gripping and when the fights get really fired up, it's a joy to play. The skyboxes are interesting and varied but the level design is a little lazy. The boss fights are great, with the glaring exception of the very last one. If you're a fan of Warhammer 40K media, you'll find the developers were definitely also fans and did a great job translating that media to a first person game. Bolters are accurately represented as being more like a MK19 than a small arm, dismembering Orks with exploding bolts. The chainsword is vicious and satisfying, and the jump packs are also accurate to the lore and fun to use.

I'd say as far as 40K games and hack and slashers go, this is one of the better ones, though you'll likely only get 10-15 hours of play out of it, if that. Catch it on sale and remember to skip the DLC if it's an additional charge.
